deployment_payload_savings.edge_bundle_efficiency: Excluding these 47 unreferenced files shrinks static deployment payload by 34.06 MB (61.22% reduction)

phase_1_baseline_reconciliation.phase_1_baseline_description: Phase 1 initial audit identified ~46 unreferenced assets (~18 MB dead weight) including 8K wallpaper renders, master crops, and raw dish JPEGs.
phase_1_baseline_reconciliation.explanation: The 47 unreferenced files consist of: (1) 44 legacy dead weight media assets (18.74 MB), (2) 2 Phase 2 companion optimization staging assets (the_golden_oak_interior.optimized.glb and forest_env.optimized.hdr totaling 6.53 MB), and (3) 1 preserved master GLB model (warrior_scene.glb, 9.66 MB) which is preserved on disk per tests/shared-3d-model.test.mjs but excluded from the edge bundle since the app uses warrior_model.glb (647 KB).

unreferenced_assets.reason: Original 10.12 MB uncompressed GLB scene preserved intact on disk per test suite invariant (tests/shared-3d-model.test.mjs); active UI uses Draco-compressed warrior_model.glb (647 KB)
